transcription: I'm not my brother's darn secretary but his manager won't stop texting me, so yeah. This has been bugging me for a while and I just need to get it off my chest. I 26 female and my brother Mike 24 male work in different areas of the same company. We have different managers. Mine is honestly amazing, super chill and actually respects my time. Mike's manager Gary like 50ish? Is a whole different story. Years ago when Mike started ignoring calls and turned off notifications for our work gap he is anxiety and dislikes being contacted constantly, Gary just. Started texting me instead. Like, I guess because I usually reply quick, he figured I could just pass the messages along? At first I didn't think much of it. It was occasional. But now, it's literally E very time he needs Mike to work or cover someone. He doesn't even try to message Mike anymore. Just straight to me. And it's not even my department I've told him like three times that I'm not the middleman. I even said hey, I'm not Mike's assistant, please talk to him directly. Didn't work. It's gotten to the point where I looked back through our texts and every single one since Mike got rehired has been about Mike. Not a single one was even directed to me. He even messaged me while I was on vacation. At the darn airport. Asking if Mike could work a weekend. Like, are you serious? Anyway, I didn't reply to his last message and I'm thinking of just blocking his number at this point. I already told him I'm done relaying messages.
